speaker: NAIM
description: NAIM should sound like: Young adult male; Light and amused tone; Casual friendly delivery; Uses humor to deflate tension ('Welcome to the idiot club'); Direct when listing motivations; Amused and lighthearted; Teasing but supportive friend; Observant and insightful; Welcoming to peers; Pragmatic about motivations (money, fame, duty).
ref_text: That sort of thing is all he does in his free time. The real question is just how long your patience will last before you tell him to knock it off already and go home.
